findings.summary: A legacy Supabase service-role credential was committed to debug scripts. Its value is excluded from harness artifacts.
remediationCompleted: Removed detected JWT and private-key patterns from the current tracked tree.
Disabled the legacy Supabase JWT-based anon and service_role API keys.
Resolved GitHub secret-scanning alert 1 as revoked.
Kept GitHub secret scanning and push protection enabled.
findings.resolution: The exposed legacy service_role API key was revoked by disabling the project's JWT-based API keys. GitHub recorded the alert resolution as revoked.
findings.nextAction: Keep legacy JWT-based API keys disabled and migrate any intentionally retained legacy consumer to scoped publishable or secret API keys.
